titolo: Google launches Genie 4 world model with audio and real‑time editing
descr: Genie 4, a research‑preview world model, adds photorealistic visuals, real‑time audio and live prompt‑based edits, expanding to two‑minute simulations.
paragrafi: Google DeepMind unveiled Genie 4 as a research preview on October 27, 2026. The model generates photorealistic, interactive worlds and includes real‑time audio such as music, ambient sounds and dialogue.

Users can modify simulations mid‑run with natural‑language prompts, changing weather, camera angles, or adding objects and characters. Simulations now last up to two minutes, double the duration of Genie 3.
Genie 4 runs on Gemini 3.8 Flash, which coordinates the visual generation while Gemini acts as a director.
Google pitches Genie 4 for pre‑visualization in film, game prototyping and robot training scenarios. The company notes that longer runs may suffer detail drift and audio accuracy challenges.

The release follows recent industry moves, including Runway’s GWM Worlds 2 and acquisitions such as AMD buying World Labs. Google positions Genie 4 as a step toward hybrid world models that blend text generation and real‑time simulation.
perche: Genie 4 offers creators a more immersive, editable AI‑generated environment, potentially speeding up storyboarding and robotics testing. For users preferring free or locally hosted models, the research‑preview remains cloud‑based, highlighting the gap between cutting‑edge proprietary tools and open‑source alternatives.
